facts.fact: Simon 动手替"我"剪掉蓄了多年的厚发，剪法像裁开一匹厚布，"我"每叫疼一次他就停手说"好，我马上停"。
facts.anchor: Simon cleaved through my thick locks as though cutting a bolt of heavy cloth

facts.fact: 剪完冲进卧室照镜，镜中倒影既像"我"又不像"我"，"我"觉得自己像电影杂志里的 vamp 或社交版广告里的 flapper。
facts.anchor: The reflection that stared back at me was mine and not mine

facts.fact: 剪发时"我"发觉 Simon 手指温暖，身上有 hashish 香烟混着皮革与 civet 的气味，并惊奇地认出那是古龙水。
facts.anchor: he smelled wonderful, of hashish cigarettes but also of leather and civet

facts.fact: Tamsin 用吻作答，一手扣住"我"的后颈、另一手滑到"我"大腿之间，"我"轻声呻吟后还是把她推开。
facts.anchor: one hand clasping the back of my neck, the other sliding down to rest between my thighs

facts.fact: 剪下的头发被塞进废纸篓，"我"想烧掉它，Tamsin 提醒那样会发臭。
facts.anchor: I wanted to burn it but Tamsin pointed out it would stink

facts.fact: 晚饭桌上父亲强装高兴地招呼大家，其实已经醉了，只有 Martin 和"我"看得出来；他盯着"我"的头发失声惊问。
facts.anchor: He was drunk, though only Martin and I knew him well enough to be aware of that

facts.fact: 晚饭后连续几夜没有留声机音乐也没有跳舞，"我"不用任何人说明就知道 Martin 不想做任何可能留住 Kelville 的事。
facts.anchor: I knew without being told that Martin didn’t want to do anything that might encourage Kelville to stay

facts.fact: 在门厅分手时"我"对 Simon 点破 Martin 的战术是把大家无聊到死，Simon 承认这招已经奏效。
facts.anchor: He’s trying to bore us to death
